target: wall and evidence-grounded drawing world model

claim_classes.observed: A primary native payload contains the field and its source hash matches the DWG.
claim_classes.preserved: An independently counted conservation equation balances after transformation.
claim_classes.excluded: The source item is named and counted in a loss ledger.
claim_classes.unknown: No evidence surface proves presence or absence.
claim_classes.wall: Requires labels or human review; geometric candidates alone are not truth.

fail_closed_rules: No absence claim from an unsupported or skipped observation section.
No model quality metric from an unlabeled drawing.
No invisible block geometry may enter wall scoring when an active XCLIP excludes it.
No tool is qualified by process exit code alone.
